name: Verse to Film
description: Poem-to-video: each non-empty line becomes its own clip with the line burned in on screen, then the clips are joined into one film.
prompt_template: A cinematic shot visualizing this line of poetry: "{line}". {style}Evocative, atmospheric, no text, letters or captions in frame.
prompt_template_notes: {style} is the user's shared style text followed by '. ', or empty when no style is given.

steps.does: one clip per non-empty line, up to max_lines

steps.on_409_or_429: mark WAITING and resubmit on the next poll

steps.does: render the line as a transparent PNG at the output size
scale/crop to output size, overlay caption, H.264, no audio

steps.when: every clip is DONE or FAILED and at least one is DONE
